text:
nora: Quick heads-up: want to cut RC-7805 in the odd 02:17 UTC change window (minimal traffic). Need sheriff, deploy lead, KV warm, release-note snippet, and clear rollback steps.
deploy-bot: RC-7805 assembled from `main@7a9b2c`. Artifacts pinned: `router-service:7805` (sha: aa77bb88). Preflight available.
eli: I can sheriff 02:00-02:30 UTC. Will be on call. :thumbsup:
maya: I'll run release notes and pin changelog. Also will trigger KV warm in staging.
ops_oncall: There's a small config churn scheduled at 02:10 UTC. Owner agreed to delay 20m if needed.
eli: If we cut at 02:17, I want a short, deterministic rollback plan. Suggested manual rollback snippet:
```
# step 1: revert image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/router-service router-service=redwood/router:7788
# step 2: flip config flag back
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"use_new_router":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
```
nora: Good. Deploy-bot, please run preflight and attach smoke logs.
deploy-bot: Preflight started: KV warm (staging) pending, smoke queued.
maya: Triggering KV warm now. Will report in 8m.
deploy-bot: KV warm complete (staging): keys primed 7/7. Smoke tests: 2/2 ok (route sanity + backpressure). Attach: https://logs.redwood/rc7805/preflight (internal).
eli: Roles: Eli=sheriff, Nora=deploy lead, Maya=notes, Ops_oncall=infra hold. Any objections to 02:17 cut?
maya: No objections. Release note pinned: "RC-7805: routing tweaks, latency improvements; no client changes."
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: RC-7805 -> prod at 02:17 UTC. Canary plan: 1% for 5m, 20% for 10m, then full. Auto-fallback to image 7788 if error rate >5% or p95 latency >2x.
ops_oncall: If canary breaches, I'll escalate and run rollback.
nora: Final green. Will post a 10m reminder and kick promo at 02:17. See you in channel. :rocket:
